editorial.blurb: Taco City is an authentic Mexican gem in Logan Square where every dish—from perfectly charred pastor tacos to hand-pressed fresh tortillas—tastes like it came straight from someone's abuela's kitchen.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about modifications without hesitation; the team happily customizes dishes like taco salads for dietary preferences, and arrive early enough to enjoy their complimentary fresh-pressed tortilla chips at your table.
